title: The torsion bound on an arbitrary algebraic curve
statement:
Let $X$ be a
separated finite-type
scheme of dimension at most one over an algebraically closed
field. Put $e=1$ if $X$ is affine, and $e=2$ otherwise.
Then $\operatorname{cd}_{\rm tor}(X)\leq e$, in the sense of
[def-sc-etale-torsion-cd].

proof.text: Use the existing upstream theorem `AlgebraicGeometry.IsCurve.hasTorsionCohomologicalDimensionLE` with the `IsCurve` instance supplied by the dimension bound. For each bound, transport the resulting subsingleton statement for `Sheaf.H` across the natural isomorphism `Scheme.nonempty_sheafH_extDerivedIso` to obtain the required derived étale cohomology subsingleton. Splitting on `IsAffine X` selects the bound one or two.

proof_origin.place: Reduction to the upstream curve bound and Sheaf.H/derived comparison
